hexstrike.description: HexStrike AI — offensive-security MCP, 150+ tools (github.com/0x4m4/hexstrike-ai). The REST server and the security tools run on one host; the bridge is launched there over ssh.
args: cd $HOME/hexstrike-ai && export PYTHONIOENCODING=utf-8 && exec ./hexstrike-env/bin/python hexstrike_mcp.py --server http://127.0.0.1:8888
hexstrike.label: Remote · HexStrike on another machine

service.hint: install: git clone https://github.com/0x4m4/hexstrike-ai; python3 -m venv hexstrike-env; ./hexstrike-env/bin/pip install -r requirements.txt. Run ./hexstrike-env/bin/python hexstrike_server.py --port 8888 by hand on the host to see startup errors. The scanning tools (nmap, gobuster, nuclei, ...) are separate installs.
